description: This file defines the class `ReviewerRatingDecorator` within the `OrangeHRM` project. The class serves as a decorator for the `ReviewerRating` entity, providing methods to set related KPI data and accessing the underlying reviewer rating object. It uses traits for ORM helper functions and manages external entity references.

classes.name: ReviewerRatingDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that wraps a `ReviewerRating` entity, allowing additional methods and encapsulation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a `ReviewerRating` entity instance.

methods.name: setKpiByKpiId
methods.description: Sets the KPI for the reviewer rating using a KPI ID, fetching the KPI entity via a reference.
